create_model_option: create a Click option decorator for specifying the model used in the agent with -m flag
create_provider_option: create a Click option decorator for specifying the model provider with -mp flag and backward compatibility alias
create_core_agent_options: create a composite decorator that adds model, provider, endpoint, and agent options to a Click command
create_runtime_config_options: create a composite decorator that adds oracle mode, simulated generation time, noise, and concurrency options
create_common_options: create a composite decorator that combines core agent options and logging configuration for all CLIs
